crossrefs.text: Her husband is known at the city gate, where he sits among the elders of the land.

But if the man does not want to marry his brotherʼs widow, she is to go to the elders at the city gate and say, “My husbandʼs brother refuses to preserve his brotherʼs name in Israel. He is not willing to perform the duty of a brother-in-law for me.”
Yes, it is true that I am a kinsman-redeemer, but there is a redeemer nearer than I.
Then Jezebel wrote letters in Ahabʼs name, sealed them with his seal, and sent them to the elders and nobles who lived with Naboth in his city.
Then Judah said to Onan, “Sleep with your brotherʼs wife. Perform your duty as her brother-in-law and raise up offspring for your brother.”

When brothers dwell together and one of them dies without a son, the widow must not marry outside the family. Her husbandʼs brother is to take her as his wife and fulfill the duty of a brother-in-law for her.
The first son she bears will carry on the name of the dead brother, so that his name will not be blotted out from Israel.
“Teacher,” they said, “Moses declared that if a man dies without having children, his brother is to marry the widow and raise up offspring for him.

crossrefs.text: And Leah conceived and gave birth to a son, and she named him Reuben, for she said, “The Lordhas seen my affliction. Surely my husband will love me now.”
She named him Joseph, and said, “May the Lordadd to me another son.”
But when he pulled his hand back and his brother came out, she said, “You have broken out first!” So he was named Perez.

But if the man does not want to marry his brotherʼs widow, she is to go to the elders at the city gate and say, “My husbandʼs brother refuses to preserve his brotherʼs name in Israel. He is not willing to perform the duty of a brother-in-law for me.”
And his family name in Israel will be called “The House of the Unsandaled.”

Abraham agreed to Ephronʼs terms and weighed out for him the price he had named in the hearing of the Hittites: four hundred shekels of silver, according to the standard of the merchants. So Ephronʼs field at Machpelah near Mamre, the cave that was in it, and all the trees within the boundaries of the field were deeded over to Abrahamʼs possession in the presence of all the Hittites who had come to the gate of his city.
And they blessed Rebekah and said to her, “Our sister, may you become the mother of thousands upon thousands. May your offspring possess the gates of their enemies.”
Since Jacob loved Rachel, he answered, “I will serve you seven years for your younger daughter Rachel.” Laban replied, “Better that I give her to you than to another. Stay here with me.”

crossrefs.text: Cast your burden upon the LORD and He will sustain you; He will never let the righteous be shaken.
When the Lordsaw that Leah was unloved, He opened her womb; but Rachel was barren.
When Esau looked up and saw the women and children, he asked, “Who are these with you?” Jacob answered, “These are the children God has graciously given your servant.”
And there I will provide for you, because there will be five more years of famine. Otherwise, you and your household and everything you own will come to destitution.’
Even to your old age, I will be the same, and I will bear you up when you turn gray. I have made you, and I will carry you; I will sustain you and deliver you.

Boaz replied, “I have been made fully aware of all you have done for your mother-in-law since the death of your husband, how you left your father and mother and the land of your birth, and how you came to a people you did not know before.
May the LORD repay your work, and may you receive a rich reward from the LORD, the God of Israel, under whose wings you have taken refuge.”
And now do not be afraid, my daughter. I will do for you whatever you request, since all my fellow townspeople know that you are a woman of noble character.

Now the LORD said to Samuel, “How long are you going to mourn for Saul, since I have rejected him as king over Israel? Fill your horn with oil and go. I am sending you to Jesse of Bethlehem, for I have selected from his sons a king for Myself.”

Tamar, Judahʼs daughter-in-law, bore to him Perez and Zerah. Judah had five sons in all. The sons of Perez: Hezron and Hamul. The sons of Zerah: Zimri, Ethan, Heman, Calcol, and Dara—five in all. The son of Carmi: Achar, who brought trouble upon Israel by violating the ban on devoted things. The son of Ethan: Azariah.
The sons who were born to Hezron: Jerahmeel, Ram, and Caleb. Ram was the father of Amminadab, and Amminadab was the father of Nahshon, a leader of the descendants of Judah.
